about: Menelik, crowned as David king of Ethiopia, is to be attended by the firstborn sons of Israel's nobles, who take their fathers' offices; the officers are named and Solomon's gifts are given. The parents weep and curse the king in secret, then flatter him to his face; the chapter closes on the king's patience and the doctrine that God's spirit rests in the king's heart.

sentences.n: Chapter heading. ደቂቀ is the construct of ደቂቅ 'sons, children': 'sons-of'; ኀይለ is the construct form of ኀይል 'strength, force, host', the second link of the chain ደቂቀ ኀይለ እስራኤል: 'sons of the strength-of Israel' (ኀይል also means 'army', hence 'host' in i). ተአዘዙ is 3mp perfect of the passive-reflexive stem of አዘዘ 'command' (the T stem can also mean 'obey' (?)). sentences.l: Land-indeed rejoiced concerning that-he-made-king his-son king, and-made-him king from-its-border to border-of another;
sentences.i: The land, for its part, rejoiced because he had made his son king, and had set him as king from its own border to the border of another land;
sentences.n: ሀገርሰ is ሀገር 'city, land' + the particle -ሰ 'indeed, for its part', which sets this clause against the next. ተፈሥሐት is 3fs perfect (ሀገር is feminine). በእንተ ዘ- 'on account of that which', hence 'because'; ዘአንገሠ is አንገሠ, the causative of ነግሠ 'reign': 'he made king'. ወልዶ is ወልድ + -ሁ 'his', contracted; ንጉሥ the second object, 'king'. ወረሰዮ is ወ- + ረሰየ 'set, make' + -ዮ 'him'; ንጉሠ is the predicate accusative, 'as king'. እምደወሉ 'from his/its border' and ደወለ ባዕድ 'the border of another' (construct + ባዕድ 'other, foreign'). ደወል 'border' is a doubtful word to me (?): the sense 'from his own frontier to a foreign frontier' fits, and the lexicon is not at hand.

sentences.i: And those of the right hand, likewise let them sit, as their fathers sit with King Solomon: likewise let them sit at the right of his son David, king of Ethiopia. And those of the left hand, likewise let them sit, as their fathers sit with King Solomon: likewise let them sit at the left of his son David, king of Ethiopia;
sentences.n: The court is arranged in two ranks, right hand (የማን) and left hand (ፀጋም), the sons taking the places their fathers hold beside Solomon. ወእለኒ is ወ- + እለ 'those who' + the enclitic -ኒ 'also'. ይንበሩ is the 3mp subjunctive (here a jussive, 'let them sit') and ይነብሩ the 3mp imperfect, 'they sit'; ነበረ means both 'dwell' and 'sit'. በከመ 'in the way that, as'. በየማነ 'at the right of' (construct). Note በፀጋሙ ለወልዱ, literally 'at his left, of his son': a suffix anticipates a possessor that is then named with ለ-, a pattern that will return (ልቡ ለንጉሥ in the last unit). 'David, king of Ethiopia' is the throne-name of Solomon's son (Menelik), as the book has told it.

sentences.n: A list of five measures, each with በከመ 'according to'. በበሥርዐቱ is the distributive በበ- 'each by each' + ሥርዐት 'order, rank' + -ሁ. The last three are uncertain without the lexicon.

sentences.i: Let them be just as Solomon did for his nobles; and likewise let David also do for them, for his own nobles. And as Solomon ordained them for his stewards (?), so also let David set in order the ordinance of his house.
sentences.n: ይኩኑ is the 3mp subjunctive of ኮነ 'be'; ገብረ 'did'; ይግበር 'let him do' (3ms jussive) with ሎሙ 'to them'. መኳንንት is the plural of መኰንን 'noble, governor' (ለመኳንንቲሁ 'for his nobles'). The enclitic -ሂ in ዳዊትሂ is 'also'. ሠርዖሙ is ሠርዐ 'ordain, set in order' + -ሙ 'them'; ይሥራዕ the jussive, and ሥርዐተ the construct 'ordinance-of' before ቤቱ 'his house'. ለመገብቱ is uncertain (?): taken, as in ch. 29 and 38–39, as the plural መገብት 'stewards' (from the root of መጋቢ below) + -ሁ 'his', with ለ- 'for'; 'his service' is the other possibility. The ፨ closing this unit marks the end of the general rule; the list of names follows. Solomon's court order is the model Menelik is to copy, the Jerusalem order carried over to the new Zion.

sentences.n: ወከመ ዝ 'and as this', introducing the list. ተሠይሙ is the 3mp perfect of the passive (tä-stem) of ሠየመ 'appoint'; ይትፈነዉ the 3mp subjunctive of the passive of ፈነወ 'send', 'that they be sent'. The names that follow are almost all in the pattern ወ- + name + ወልደ 'son of' + father's name + office. ወልደ is the construct, 'son-of', so each office is in apposition to the son. Most of these men are not otherwise known to me, and the forms are given as Bezold has them.

appoint (3mp perfect, passive T stem 'were appointed'; ለእለ ተሠይሙ 'of those appointed')

sentences.t: አዛርያስ ፡ ወልደ ፡ ሳዶቅ ፡ ካህን ፡ ዝውእቱ ፡ ሊቀ ፡ ካህናት ፤
sentences.tr: ʾäzaryas wäldä sadoq kahn zəwʾətu liqä kahnat
sentences.l: Azaryas son-of Zadok, priest, this-is chief-of priests;
sentences.i: Azariah son of Zadok, the priest, who is the high priest;
sentences.n: Azariah son of Zadok the priest is named among Solomon's officials in 1 Kings 4:2, which is the model here. ሊቀ ካህናት is 'chief-of priests' (ሊቅ 'chief, elder', construct ሊቀ; ካህናት the plural of ካህን), so 'high priest' by its parts. ዝውእቱ is ዝ + ውእቱ, 'this is he', an appositional 'that is'; the same word will recur.

morph.gloss: Azariah (proper name; here son of Zadok, high priest)
this is he, that is (he who) · 'this very one', ዝ + ውእቱ in apposition (ዝውእቱ ብሩሀ ገጽ ይኩን 'let this one, bright of face, be…')

sentences.t: ወኤልያስ ፡ ወልደ ፡ አርኒ ፡ ሊቀ ፡ ዲያቆናት ፡ ወአቡሁሰ ፡ ለአርኒ ፡ ሊቀ ፡ ዲያቆናት ፡ ናታን ፡ ነቢይ ፤
sentences.tr: wäʾelyas wäldä ʾärni liqä diyaqonat wäʾäbuhusä läʾärni liqä diyaqonat natan näbiy
sentences.l: And-Elyas son-of Arni, chief-of deacons; and-his-father-indeed, of-Arni chief-of deacons, Nathan prophet;
sentences.i: And Elijah son of Arni, chief of deacons; and the father of Arni, chief of deacons, was Nathan the prophet;
sentences.n: ዲያቆናት is the plural of ዲያቆን (Greek diakonos), 'deacon', so ሊቀ ዲያቆናት 'chief-of deacons'. The second half is hard to parse: ወአቡሁሰ ለአርኒ is 'and as for his father, that of Arni' (አቡሁ + ሰ 'indeed', with the anticipatory ለ- naming the possessor), and I take ናታን ነቢይ as the predicate, so Arni's father is Nathan the prophet (the ሊቀ ዲያቆናት after Arni being a repeated title). It could also be read as Nathan being Elijah's father (?); the grammar favours Arni. Nathan the prophet is David's prophet in 2 Samuel 7 and 1 Kings 1.

morph.gloss: Elijah, Elias (proper name; here a personal name, son of Arni; ወ- 'and')
deacon (noun, plural ዲያቆናት; ሊቀ ዲያቆናት 'chief of deacons')

አርኒ (personal name, unidentified) ; ለ- 'of, belonging to' marking the possessor
deacon (noun, plural ዲያቆናት; ሊቀ ዲያቆናት 'chief of deacons')

sentences.t: ወአድራም ፡ ወልደ ፡ አርድሮንስ ፡ መልአከ ፡ አሕዛብ ፤
sentences.tr: wäʾädram wäldä ʾärdərons mälʾäkä ʾäḥzab
sentences.l: And-Adram son-of Ardrons, messenger-of peoples;
sentences.i: And Adram son of Ardrons, messenger of the peoples;
sentences.n: መልአክ is 'messenger' (also 'angel'); in an office list it is the head or envoy of a department, so መልአከ አሕዛብ is 'messenger-of peoples' (አሕዛብ, plural of ሕዝብ), perhaps an overseer of the foreign peoples or nations (?). The names Adram and Ardrons are unidentified.

sentences.t: ወፈንቄራ ፡ ወልደ ፡ ሶባ ፡ ጸሓፌ ፡ ላህም ፤
sentences.tr: wäfänqera wäldä soba ṣäḥafe lahm
sentences.l: And-Fanqera son-of Soba, scribe-of cattle;
sentences.i: And Fanqera son of Soba, scribe of the cattle;
sentences.n: ጸሓፌ is the construct of ጸሓፊ 'scribe' (the ending -ኤ is the construct of nouns in -ኢ), so 'scribe-of'; ላህም is 'cow, cattle, herd'. A recorder over the royal herds (?).

sentences.t: ወአኮንሔል ፡ ወልደ ፡ ጦፌል ፡ እንዘ ፡ ሕፃን ፤
sentences.tr: wäʾäkonḥel wäldä ṭofel ʾənzä ḥəṣ́an
sentences.l: And-Akonhel son-of Tofel, while child;
sentences.i: And Akonhel son of Tofel, still a child;
sentences.n: እንዘ 'while' + a nominal predicate: 'while a child' (ሕፃን). A young man is named among the officers, which is to say that these were sons succeeding fathers.

sentences.t: ወሳምንያስ ፡ ወልደ ፡ አኪታለም ፡ መዘክር ፤
sentences.tr: wäsamnəyas wäldä ʾäkitaläm mäzäkr
sentences.l: And-Samnyas son-of Akitalem, recorder;
sentences.i: And Samnyas son of Akitalem, recorder;
sentences.n: መዘክር 'one who recalls, remembrancer', from ዘከረ 'remember'; it matches the 'recorder' (Hebrew mazkir) of David's and Solomon's courts in 2 Samuel 8:16 and 1 Kings 4:3.

morph.gloss: recorder, remembrancer (noun; the office of mazkir)

sentences.t: ወፈቃሮስ ፡ ወልደ ፡ ንያ ፡ መልአከ ፡ ሰርዌ ፡ ዝውእቱ ፡ ሊቀ ፡ ሐራ ፤
sentences.tr: wäfäqaros wäldä nəya mälʾäkä särwe zəwʾətu liqä ḥära
sentences.l: And-Faqaros son-of Nya, messenger-of host (?), this-is chief-of soldiers;
sentences.i: And Faqaros son of Nya, messenger of the host (?), who is the chief of the soldiers;
sentences.n: ሰርዌ I take as 'host, army' (cf. ሠራዊት), though I also know a ሰርዌ 'creeping thing, serpent', so the word is hedged (?), and ሐራ is 'soldiers'; ሊቀ ሐራ 'chief-of soldiers' is a commander. ዝውእቱ again glosses the first title by the second.

morph.gloss: host, army (noun; cf. ሠራዊት; a ሰርዌ 'creeping thing, serpent' also exists, so uncertain) (?)
this is he, that is (he who) · 'this very one', ዝ + ውእቱ in apposition (ዝውእቱ ብሩሀ ገጽ ይኩን 'let this one, bright of face, be…')
soldiers, army, host (noun, collective; ሊቀ ሐራ 'chief of soldiers')

sentences.t: ወሌዋንዶስ ፡ ወልደ ፡ አኪሬ ፡ መልአከ ፡ አንገቦት ፤
sentences.tr: wälewandos wäldä ʾäkire mälʾäkä ʾängäbot
sentences.l: And-Lewandos son-of Akire, messenger-of angebot (?);
sentences.i: And Lewandos son of Akire, messenger of the angebot (?);
sentences.n: አንገቦት is a word I cannot place (?). It looks like a plural in -ት; I leave it untranslated rather than guess a meaning.

morph.gloss: unidentified word, perhaps a title or office (?) (noun, after መልአከ 'messenger of')

sentences.t: ወፋቁጤን ፡ ወልደ ፡ አድራይ ፡ መልአካዊ ፡ ለባሕር ፤
sentences.tr: wäfaquṭen wäldä ʾädray mälʾäkawi läbaḥr
sentences.l: And-Faqetin son-of Adray, messenger-ish for-sea;
sentences.i: And Faqetin son of Adray, the one over the sea (?);
sentences.n: መልአካዊ is built on መልአክ 'messenger' with the adjective ending -ዊ ('messenger-like, angelic'); ለባሕር 'of the sea'. The title seems to mean a commissioner or admiral of the sea (?), but the form is odd and I am not sure.

morph.gloss: one in charge, 'messenger-like' (adjective/noun from መልአክ; uncertain) (?)

sentences.t: ወማታን ፡ ወልደ ፡ ብንያስ ፡ መልህቀ ፡ ቤት ፤
sentences.tr: wämatan wäldä bənyas mälhəqä bet
sentences.l: And-Matan son-of Bnyas, anchor-of house (?);
sentences.i: And Matan son of Bnyas, 'anchor of the house' (?);
sentences.n: መልህቅ is, as far as I recall, 'anchor'; as a title before ቤት 'house' it may be a figure ('the anchor of the house') or from a root meaning 'great' (?). Either way it is an office in the palace and uncertain.

morph.gloss: ማታን (personal name, unidentified) ; cf. Mattan; ወ- 'and'
anchor (noun, construct 'anchor of'; uncertain sense as a title) (?)

sentences.t: ወአድዐረዝ ፡ ወልደ ፡ ኪሬም ፡ ደቀ ፡ ሰርጒ ፤
sentences.tr: wäʾädʿäräz wäldä kirem däqä särgʷi
sentences.l: And-Adʿarez son-of Kirem, servant-of Sergu (?);
sentences.i: And Adʿarez son of Kirem, servant of Sergu (?);
sentences.n: ደቀ is the construct of ደቅ 'servant, youth, disciple'; ደቅ is also the singular of ደቂቅ 'sons' (unit 0), so 'child-of' is as possible as 'servant-of' (?). ሰርጒ is unclear: a place or personal name, or a word for a feast (?). I do not translate beyond that.

morph.gloss: child, youth, servant (noun, construct 'child of'; the singular beside ደቂቅ 'sons'; sense here uncertain) (?)

sentences.t: ወደለክም ፡ ወልደ ፡ ማትሬም ፡ ሊቀ ፡ ሐራ ፡ ለአፍራስ ፤
sentences.tr: wädäläkm wäldä matrem liqä ḥära läʾäfras
sentences.l: And-Delekem son-of Matrem, chief-of soldiers for-horses;
sentences.i: And Delekem son of Matrem, chief of the soldiers of the horses;
sentences.n: ሊቀ ሐራ ለአፍራስ 'chief-of soldiers, of horses' (አፍራስ the plural of ፈረስ 'horse'), that is, commander of the cavalry. The ለ- here marks the possessor.

morph.gloss: soldiers, army, host (noun, collective; ሊቀ ሐራ 'chief of soldiers')

sentences.t: ወአደርዮስ ፡ ወልደ ፡ ኔድሮስ ፡ ሊቀ ፡ ሐራ ፡ ለአጋር ፤
sentences.tr: wäʾädäryos wäldä nedros liqä ḥära läʾägar
sentences.l: And-Aderyos son-of Nedros, chief-of soldiers for-Agar (?);
sentences.i: And Aderyos son of Nedros, chief of the soldiers of Agar (?);
sentences.n: The same pattern. አጋር is uncertain (?): it may be Hagar or the Hagarenes (Arabs) as a people or place, or another word entirely. Left as Agar.

morph.gloss: soldiers, army, host (noun, collective; ሊቀ ሐራ 'chief of soldiers')
Hagar, or the Hagarenes (proper name, ለ- 'to, of'; uncertain) (?)

sentences.t: ወአውስጥራን ፡ ወልደ ፡ ዮዳድ ፡ ጸዋሬ ፡ ክብር ፤
sentences.tr: wäʾäwsəṭran wäldä yodad ṣäware kəbr
sentences.l: And-Awstran son-of Yodad, bearer-of glory;
sentences.i: And Awstran son of Yodad, bearer of glory;
sentences.n: ጸዋሬ is the construct of ጸዋሪ 'bearer, carrier' (from ጸውረ 'carry'); ክብር 'glory, honour'. Perhaps the bearer of the royal regalia or honours (?).

sentences.t: ወአስተርአዮን ፡ ወልደ ፡ አሳ ፡ ቃለ ፡ ታዕካ ፤
sentences.tr: wäʾästärʾäyon wäldä ʾäsa qalä taʿka
sentences.l: And-Asteraeyon son-of Asa, voice-of taʿka (?);
sentences.i: And Asteraeyon son of Asa, voice of the taʿka (?);
sentences.n: ቃለ is the construct of ቃል 'word, voice', so 'voice-of'; ታዕካ is a word I am unsure of (?): it looks like a court or audience-place, and it recurs two units below. So this may be a herald or spokesman of the court (?).

morph.gloss: Asa (personal name here, father of Asteraeyon; unidentified)
word (construct 'word of') · accusative 'a word' (ዘንተ ቃለ 'this word') · 'voice of' in the title ቃለ ታዕካ (?)
unidentified word, perhaps a title, place or object (noun; the 'taʿka') (?)

sentences.t: ወኢሚ ፡ ወልደ ፡ መታትያስ ፡ ሊቀ ፡ መጽብእት ፤
sentences.tr: wäʾimi wäldä mätatyas liqä mäṣbəʾt
sentences.l: And-Imi son-of Matatyas, chief-of battles;
sentences.i: And Imi son of Matatyas, chief of battles;
sentences.n: መጽብእት is 'battle, war', from ጸብአ 'fight'; ሊቀ መጽብእት 'chief-of battles' is a war-leader.

morph.gloss: Mattathias (personal name, here father of Imi; conventional English from the form)
battle, war (noun, fem.; ሊቀ መጽብእት 'chief of battles')

sentences.t: ወማክሪ ፡ ወልደ ፡ አቢሳ ፡ ፈታሔ ፡ ታዕካ ፤
sentences.tr: wämakri wäldä ʾäbisa fätaḥe taʿka
sentences.l: And-Makri son-of Abisa, judge-of taʿka (?);
sentences.i: And Makri son of Abisa, judge of the taʿka (?);
sentences.n: ፈታሔ is the construct of ፈታሒ 'judge'. The word ታዕካ again (?).

morph.gloss: unidentified word, perhaps a title, place or object (noun; the 'taʿka') (?)

sentences.t: ወአቢስ ፡ ወልደ ፡ ካርዮስ ፡ መአስሪ ፤

sentences.l: And-Abis son-of Karyos, tithe-taker (?);
sentences.i: And Abis son of Karyos, tithe-taker (?);

morph.gloss: tithe-taker, collector of tenths (agent noun, perhaps from ዐሠረ 'take a tenth'; the spelling with አ and ስ makes it uncertain) (?)

sentences.t: ሊቀ ፡ ውንድዮስ ፡ ወልደ ፡ ኔልንት ፡ ዮስ ፡ መስፍነ ፡ ዐውድ ፤
sentences.tr: liqä wəndəyos wäldä nelnət yos mäsfənä ʿäwd
sentences.l: Chief-of Wundeyos son-of Nelnt Yos, ruler-of circuit;
sentences.i: Chief Wundeyos son of Nelnt Yos, ruler of the district;
sentences.n: ሊቀ here stands before the name instead of before the office, and ኔልንት ዮስ is written as two words; both look like oddities of the source, kept as they are. መስፍን 'ruler, prince' (construct መስፍነ) and ዐውድ 'circuit, round, district' (?), so a governor of a region.

morph.gloss: ዮስ (personal name, unidentified) ; perhaps the end of the preceding name, split by the wordspace

sentences.t: ወካርሚ ፡ ወልደ ፡ ሐፃንያስ ፡ ሊቀ ፡ ገባር ፡ ዘቤተ ፡ ንጉሥ ፤

sentences.i: And Karmi son of Hatsanyas, chief of the workers of the king's house;

morph.gloss: workman, labourer (noun; agent noun of ገብረ)
of the house of (ዘ- 'of, that of' + ቤተ, construct 'house of')

sentences.i: And Sranyas son of Akazel, steward of the king's house;
sentences.n: መጋቢ is 'steward, one who provides' (?), probably from a root for providing or serving (?); the title fits a household manager. Same ዘቤተ ንጉሥ as before.

morph.gloss: ስራንያስ (personal name, unidentified) ; cf. Seraiah (?); ወ- 'and'
steward, distributor (agent noun from መገበ 'feed, distribute')
of the house of (ዘ- 'of, that of' + ቤተ, construct 'house of')

sentences.t: እሉ ፡ ኵሎሙ ፡ እለ ፡ ተውህቡ ፡ ለዳዊት ፡ ንጉሠ ፡ ኢትዮጵያ ፡ ወልደ ፡ ሰሎሞን ፡ ንጉሠ ፡ እስራኤል ፨
sentences.tr: ʾəlu kʷəlomu ʾəlä täwhəbu lädawit nəguśä ʾityop̣ya wäldä sälomon nəguśä ʾəsraʾel
sentences.l: These all who were-given to-David king-of Ethiopia son-of Solomon king-of Israel;

sentences.i: And he also gave him horses, riding chariots (?), mules, laden (?) chariots, gold, silver, precious garments, fine linen, a dyed stuff (?), pearls (?), [ʾäfraṣä] (?), and everything that is needed for the land of Ethiopia; he gave all this to his son;
sentences.n: ወዓዲ 'and also'. ወሀቦ is the 3ms perfect with -ኦ 'him' (Solomon gives; the same suffix comes back before ለወልዱ at the end, the anticipating pattern again). The objects have the accusative ending -ä (first order): አፍራሰ 'horses', ሰረገላተ 'chariots', አብቅልተ 'mules'. ራኵባተ is 'riding, mounted', as I read it (?); ጽዑነ is 'laden', a singular form beside plural ሰረገላተ, so the agreement is not clean (?). The source runs ሰረገላተወርቀ together; every other item has its own ወ-, so I take it as ሰረገላተ + ወ- + ወርቀ with the doubled ወ written once, 'chariots, and gold' (?); 'chariots of gold' is the other reading. ቢሶሰ is Greek byssos 'fine linen'. ሜላተ is a dyed stuff, perhaps purple, unidentified (?), as in ch. 31–32. ዕንቈ ባሕርያተ is 'stone of pearls', that is pearls; ባሕርይ also means 'nature', so 'pearls' is a sense-by-context reading (?), as in ch. 30. አፍራጸ is not understood (?); as in ch. 29 it is left in transliteration rather than guessed. ዘይትፈቀድ 'what is wished for, needed' (passive of ፈቀደ). The gifts are those Solomon gave to his son.

sentences.n: በኵሩ ለሰሎሞን 'his firstborn, Solomon's' is the same ለ- possessor pattern with an anticipatory suffix. ዝውእቱ ንጉሠ ኢትዮጵያ glosses him: 'that is, the king of Ethiopia'. ተውህበ is 3ms, with the collective በኵሮሙ 'their firstborn' as subject. ከመ ይንግሡ is the 3mp subjunctive of ነግሠ; ነግሠ takes ለ- for the realm, 'reign over'. sentences.i: But to the king they say: 'You have done well in this, for your wisdom is good, in that the kingdom of Israel has come to the land of Ethiopia by the will of God and by your wisdom. And God will also hand over other kingdoms into your hand, for you think what is good toward God and you wish that they worship the God of Israel, and that the idols be rooted out of the world.'
sentences.n: ወለንጉሥሰ 'but to the king indeed' (-ሰ contrasts with their cursing in secret; they speak to his face). ይብልዎ 'they say to him'. ሠናየ ገበርከ is 'well (acc. adverb) you did' (2ms perfect). በእንተዝ 'on account of this'. ኀየሰ is the 3ms perfect of ኀየሰ 'be good, excellent' (?). መንግሥተ is the construct of መንግሥት 'kingdom', here the Israelite kingdom 'come to' Ethiopia: the translatio, the transfer of the kingdom from Israel to Ethiopia. ዚአከ 'yours' (the independent possessive; ጥበበ ዚአከ 'wisdom, yours'). ካልኣንኒ is 'others also' (ካልእ + -ኒ). ያገብኦን is አግብአ 'hand over, bring back' (as in ch. 33–34 and 41), 3ms + -ን '3fp them' (kingdoms are feminine). ትኄሊ is 2ms imperfect of ኀለየ 'think'. ያምልክዎ is አምለከ 'worship' + -ዎ 'him'. ይሠረዉ is 3mp of ሠረወ 'uproot'; ጣዖታት has no accusative ending, so I read it as the subject, 'that the idols be rooted out' (?); the active 'that they root out the idols' is the other reading. ጣዖታት 'idols'. These words are a flattering speech, because the nobles are afraid; the next unit shows that.

sentences.i: And they praise him and say: 'Now we know that it was concerning you that God said to our father Abraham: In your seed all the nations of the earth will be blessed;'
sentences.n: ይዌድስዎ is the 3mp imperfect of ወደሰ 'praise' + -ዎ 'him'. ይእዜ 'now'; አእመርነ 'we know' (1cp perfect of አእመረ). በእንቲአከ 'concerning you' (በእንተ + -ከ). ይቤሎ 'said to him' (ይቤ + -ሎ), here 'God said to Abraham'. The quotation is Genesis 22:18 (also 12:3, 26:4): 'in your seed all the nations of the earth shall be blessed'. ይትባረኩ is the 3mp passive imperfect; አሕዛበ the construct of አሕዛብ 'nations', before ምድር 'earth'. The nobles apply the blessing of Abraham's seed to Solomon's son in Ethiopia.

sentences.i: The kingdom, indeed, is God's: the whole earth, and the heavens too, and the ends of the world, and the sea and the dry land he himself rules;
sentences.n: መንግሥትሰ ለእግዚኣብሔር 'the kingdom indeed (belongs) to God', the ለ- of possession. Then a list that is the object of ይኴንን (ኵላ and አጽናፈ carry the accusative ending): ኵላ ምድር 'the whole earth', ሰማያትኒ 'the heavens also', አጽናፈ ዓለም 'the ends-of world', ባሕር 'sea', የብስ 'dry land'. ውእቱ ይኴንን is 'he himself rules/judges' (ኰነነ), with the pronoun ውእቱ emphasising the subject. This is the doctrine that human kings rule by delegation.

sentences.i: And to the king of the earth also he has given it, from beneath himself, that he may judge; likewise, as to those who do evil, that he repay them evil, and as to those who do good, that he reward them good;
sentences.n: ለንጉሠ ምድርሂ 'and to the king of the earth too' (-ሂ 'also'). ወሀቦ is 'gave him / it'. እምታሕቴሁ is 'from beneath him', that is, the king rules as God's subordinate. ከማሁ here is a connective 'likewise'. ይገብርዋ ለእኪት: the verb carries -ዋ '3fs it' which resumes ለእኪት 'the evil (thing)', the same anticipating pattern. ይፍድዮሙ is the 3ms subjunctive of ፈደየ 'repay' + -ሙ; ይዕስዮሙ that of ዐሰየ 'reward' + -ሙ. The source splits ሠናየ into ሠና የ, a spacing oddity; the sense is 'good'.

sentences.l: for spirit-of God rests in his-heart, of-the-king, and-his-hands in his-thought, and-his-knowledge in his-understanding.
sentences.i: for the spirit of God rests in the king's heart, and his hands in his thought, and his knowledge in his understanding.
sentences.n: መንፈሰ is the construct of መንፈስ 'spirit', 'spirit-of God'. ያዐርፍ 'rests' (3ms imperfect of the A stem አዕረፈ, used intransitively as in ch. 42); the next two clauses have no verb and 'rests' is carried over to them. ልቡ ለንጉሥ is the anticipatory suffix with ለ- again: 'his heart, of the king'. The rest is a parallel list of three, ኅሊና 'thought' and ልቡና 'understanding'. The wording recalls Isaiah 11:2 (the spirit of the Lord resting on the king) and Proverbs 21:1 (the king's heart in the Lord's hand) (?). The source ends the unit and the part with a run of eight ፨, kept attached exactly as written (the previous part also ends with eight).

glossary.ለመገብቱ: መጋቢ — for his stewards (?) (ለ- 'for' + plural መገብት + -ሁ 'his'; the sense 'steward, one who provides' is a guess from መጋቢ, as in ch. 29 and 38–39) (?)
glossary.ለሠናይት: ሠናይት — the good (noun, fem. of ሠናይ; ለ- marking the object after ይገብርዋ)
glossary.ለሰሎሞን: ሰሎሞን — Solomon (proper name; ለ- naming the possessor 'Solomon's')
glossary.ለብሔረ: ብሔር — to the land of (ለ- 'to, for' + construct) · upon (ለ- marking the place shone upon: አብርሀት ለብሔረ ኢትዮጵያ 'she shone upon the land of Ethiopia') · of the land of (ለ- marking the possessor: ሥርዐታ ለብሔረ ኢትዮጵያ 'the custom of the land of Ethiopia')
glossary.ለንጉሥ: ንጉሥ — to the king, for the king (ለ- + noun)
glossary.ለአምላከ: አምላክ — of the God of (ለ- genitive + noun, construct) · marking the object: 'the God of' after ያመልኩ/ይግነዩ (ይግነዩ ለአምላከ እስራኤል 'serve the God of Israel')
glossary.ለአርኒ: አርኒ — አርኒ (personal name, unidentified) ; ለ- 'of, belonging to' marking the possessor
glossary.ለአቡነ: አብ — to our father (ለ- + noun + -ነ '1cp our')
glossary.ለአጋር: አጋር — Hagar, or the Hagarenes (proper name, ለ- 'to, of'; uncertain) (?)
glossary.ለአፍራስ: ፈረስ — to/of horses (plural አፍራስ; ለ- 'to, for')
glossary.ለእለ: እለ — those who, who (plural relative pronoun; ለ- 'to, for')
glossary.ለእኪት: እኪት — evil (fem. adj./noun, ለ- marking object)
glossary.ለእግዚኣብሔር: እግዚአብሔር — of/to God · God as object, marked with ለ- after ፈርሆ, አምዕዕዎ, አሥመሮ
glossary.ለወልዱ: ወልድ — to his son (ለ- + noun + -ሁ '3ms his')
glossary.ሐራ: ሐራ — soldiers, army, host (noun, collective; ሊቀ ሐራ 'chief of soldiers')
glossary.ሐዘነት: ሐዘነ — grieve, mourn (3fs perfect; subject ሀገር)
glossary.ሕዘቢሆሙ: ሕዝብ — people (noun + -ሆሙ '3mp their'; stem form ሕዘቢ- before the suffix)
glossary.መልህቀ: መልህቅ — anchor (noun, construct 'anchor of'; uncertain sense as a title) (?)
glossary.መልአካዊ: መልአካዊ — one in charge, 'messenger-like' (adjective/noun from መልአክ; uncertain) (?)
glossary.መስፍነ: መስፍን — ruler, prince, governor (noun, construct 'ruler of')
glossary.መታትያስ: መታትያስ — Mattathias (personal name, here father of Imi; conventional English from the form)
glossary.መንግሥተ: መንግሥት — kingdom (construct 'kingdom of') · also the plain accusative 'a kingdom' (ዘይነፍቅ መንግሥተ 'who would seize a kingdom')
glossary.መአስሪ: መአስሪ — tithe-taker, collector of tenths (agent noun, perhaps from ዐሠረ 'take a tenth'; the spelling with አ and ስ makes it uncertain) (?)
glossary.መዘክር: መዘክር — recorder, remembrancer (noun; the office of mazkir)
glossary.መጋቢ: መጋቢ — steward, distributor (agent noun from መገበ 'feed, distribute')
glossary.መጽብእት: መጽብእት — battle, war (noun, fem.; ሊቀ መጽብእት 'chief of battles')
glossary.ምልክናሁ: ምልክና — lordship, dominion (noun + -ሁ '3ms his'; reading uncertain) (?)
glossary.ምርካቡ: ምርካብ — rank, standing (noun + -ሁ 'his'; from ረከበ 'find, obtain'; uncertain, as in ch. 38–39) (?)
glossary.ምኵናኑ: ምኵናን — authority, judgment (noun + -ሁ 'his'; from ኰነነ 'judge'; uncertain) (?)
glossary.ምድርሂ: ምድር — earth also (noun + enclitic -ሂ 'also'; ወለንጉሠ ምድርሂ 'and also to the king of the earth')
glossary.ሠርዖሙ: ሠርዐ — ordain, appoint, set in order (3ms perfect + -ሙ '3mp them')
glossary.ሠና: ሠናይ — good (accusative ሠናየ, split by the wordspace as ሠና ፡ የ)
glossary.ራኵባተ: ራኩብ — riding, mounted (adjective, fem. plural accusative ራኵባት, qualifying ሰረገላተ; uncertain) (?)
glossary.ሰረገላተወርቀ: ሰረገላ — chariots, and gold (plural ሰረገላት accusative + ወርቅ 'gold', written together without wordspace; one ወ- stands for the expected ወ- + ወርቀ, giving 'and gold'; 'chariots of gold' is the other reading) (?)
glossary.ሰርዌ: ሰርዌ — host, army (noun; cf. ሠራዊት; a ሰርዌ 'creeping thing, serpent' also exists, so uncertain) (?)
glossary.ሶባ: ሶባ — Soba (personal name, unidentified; perhaps Zobah) (?)
glossary.ቃለ: ቃል — word (construct 'word of') · accusative 'a word' (ዘንተ ቃለ 'this word') · 'voice of' in the title ቃለ ታዕካ (?)
glossary.በበሥርዐቱ: ሥርዐት — order, rank (noun + -ሁ 'his'; በበ- distributive 'each according to his')
glossary.በኅቡእ: ኅቡእ — hidden, secret (adjective as noun; በኅቡእ 'in secret')
glossary.በእንተ: በእንተ — concerning, about (+ construct) · for the sake of, on account of (በእንተ ፍሥሓ አዳም 'for the joy of Adam')
glossary.በእንተዝ: በእንተዝ — on this account, concerning this (በእንተ + ዝ, preposition + demonstrative)
glossary.በእንቲአከ: በእንተ — concerning you, on your account (በእንቲአ- + -ከ '2ms you')
glossary.በከመ: ከመ — as, in the way that (በ- 'in' + ከመ)
glossary.በኵረ: በኵር — firstborn (noun, accusative, in apposition to ደቂቅክሙ 'as firstborn')
glossary.በዘርእከ: ዘርእ — in your seed (በ- 'in' + noun + -ከ '2ms your')
glossary.በየማነ: የማን — at the right of (በ- 'at, in' + noun, construct 'right of')
glossary.በፀጋሙ: ፀጋም — at his left (በ- + noun + -ሁ '3ms his', contracted ፀጋሙ)
glossary.በፈቃደ: ፈቃድ — by the will of (በ- 'by' + noun, construct 'will of')
glossary.ቢሶሰ: ቢሶስ — byssus, fine linen (noun, loanword, accusative)
glossary.ባዕድ: ባዕድ — another, a stranger (adjective/noun; ብእሲተ ባዕድ 'another man's wife') · 'strange, foreign' (አማልክተ ባዕድ 'strange gods')
glossary.ብንያስ: ብንያስ — ብንያስ (personal name, unidentified); perhaps Benaiah (?)
glossary.ተሠይሙ: ሠየመ — appoint (3mp perfect, passive T stem 'were appointed'; ለእለ ተሠይሙ 'of those appointed')
glossary.ተሰምዩ: ሰምየ — they were called (passive ተሰምየ, 3mp perfect)
glossary.ተአዘዙ: አዘዘ — command (3mp perfect, passive-reflexive T stem ተአዘዘ 'were commanded'; the T stem can also mean 'obey' (?))
glossary.ተውህበ: ወሀበ — it was given (3ms perfect, tä-stem passive)
glossary.ተውህቡ: ወሀበ — they were given (3mp perfect, passive T stem ተውህበ)
glossary.ተደለዉ: ተደለወ — be ready, make ready (3mp perfect, T stem)
glossary.ተጋብኡ: ተጋብአ — gather, assemble (3mp perfect, T stem)
glossary.ተፈሥሐት: ተፈሥሐ — rejoice, be glad (3fs perfect, T stem; subject ሀገር)
glossary.ታዕካ: ታዕካ — unidentified word, perhaps a title, place or object (noun; the 'taʿka') (?)
glossary.ኀበ: ኀበ — to, toward, at; where (preposition / conjunction)
glossary.ኀየሰ: ኀየሰ — he excelled, was good (3ms perfect, ḫ-y-s)
glossary.ንበለ: ዘእንበለ — without, apart from (preposition; second half of the word split by the wordspace, ዘእ ፡ ንበለ)
glossary.ንጉሠ: ንጉሥ — king (accusative) · also construct 'king of' (ንጉሠ ሮምሂ 'the king of Rome too') · predicate accusative 'as king' (ዘይከውን ንጉሠ 'who will be king'; ይኩነነ ንጉሠ 'may he be king for us')
glossary.አሳ: አሳ — Asa (personal name here, father of Asteraeyon; unidentified)
glossary.አስማቲሆሙ: ስም — their names (noun, plural አስማት + -ሆሙ '3mp their')
glossary.አቢሳ: አቢሳ — Abisa, perhaps Abishai (personal name, unidentified) (?)
glossary.አንገቦት: አንገቦት — unidentified word, perhaps a title or office (?) (noun, after መልአከ 'messenger of')
glossary.አዛርያስ: አዛርያስ — Azariah (proper name; here son of Zadok, high priest)
glossary.እምታሕቴሁ: ታሕት — from beneath him (እም- 'from' + ታሕቴ- + -ሁ '3ms him'; 'under his authority')
glossary.እምየማን: የማን — right hand, right side (noun; እም- 'from, on the side of')
glossary.እምደወሉ: ደወል — from its border (እም- 'from' + noun + -ሁ '3ms its'; uncertain)
glossary.እምፀጋም: ፀጋም — left hand, left side (noun; እም- 'from, on the side of')
glossary.ከመ: ከመ — that, so that; as · 'like' before a noun (ከመ ምድረ በረድ 'like a land of hail') · ከመ ኢ- 'that not, lest' (ከመ ኢትንገሥ ብእሲት 'that a woman not reign'; ከመ ኢታቅሞ 'that you not make him stay')
glossary.ክቡረ: ክቡር — precious, honoured (adjective, accusative, qualifying አልባሰ)
glossary.ኮነት: ኮነ — become, be (3fs perfect; subject መንግሥተ)
glossary.ኵላ: ኵሉ — all, the whole (variant form ኵላ, accusative)
glossary.ወሀቦ: ወሀበ — he gave him (3ms perfect + -ኦ 3ms object) · with the -ኦ anticipating a ለ- phrase (ወሀቦ ለወልዱ 'he gave him, to his son')
glossary.ወለንጉሠ: ንጉሥ — and to the king of (ወ- + ለ- + noun, construct)
glossary.ወለንጉሥሰ: ንጉሥ — and to the king indeed (ወ- + ለ- + noun + ሰ 'indeed')
glossary.ወለእለ: እለ — and to those who (ወ- + ለ- + relative pronoun pl.)
glossary.ወልዶ: ወልድ — his son (noun, accusative + -ሁ '3ms his', contracted)
glossary.ወማታን: ማታን — ማታን (personal name, unidentified) ; cf. Mattan; ወ- 'and'
glossary.ወሜላተ: ሜላ — and (a dyed stuff) (ወ- + noun, accusative; unidentified, uncertain, perhaps purple)
glossary.ወሢመቶሙኒ: ሢመት — office, appointment, rank (noun + -ሙ '3mp their'; ወ- 'and', -ኒ 'also')
glossary.ወረሰዮ: ረሰየ — set, make, appoint (3ms perfect + -ዮ '3ms him'; ወ- 'and')
glossary.ወሰረገላተ: ሰረገላ — and carts, chariots (ወ- + plural ሰረገላት, accusative)
glossary.ወስራንያስ: ስራንያስ — ስራንያስ (personal name, unidentified) ; cf. Seraiah (?); ወ- 'and'
glossary.ወበሓውርቲሆሙ: ሓውርት — obscure noun, perhaps neighbours or companions (+ -ሆሙ '3mp their'; ወበ- 'and among'; uncertain) (?)
glossary.ወበበ: በበ — each, each one, severally (distributive particle; ወ- 'and'; before በከመ 'according to')
glossary.ወበከመ: ከመ — and as, and according as (ወ- 'and' + በ- + ከመ)
glossary.ወበጥበበ: ጥበብ — and by the wisdom of (ወ- + በ- + noun, construct)
glossary.ወአልባሰ: ልብስ — and garments (ወ- + plural አልባስ, accusative)
glossary.ወአስማቲሆሙኒ: ስም — name, title (noun, plural አስማት + -ሆሙ '3mp their'; ወ- 'and', -ኒ 'also')
glossary.ወአቡሁሰ: አብ — and as for his father (noun, ወ- + አቡ + -ሁ '3ms his' + ሰ 'indeed')
glossary.ወአብቅልተ: በቅል — and mules (ወ- + plural አብቅልት, accusative)
glossary.ወአንጋዲሆሙ: አንጋድ — obscure noun, perhaps relatives or associates (plural + -ሆሙ '3mp their'; ወ- 'and'; uncertain) (?)
glossary.ወአዝማዲሆሙ: ዘመድ — kinsman, relative (noun, plural አዝማድ + -ሆሙ '3mp their'; ወ- 'and')
glossary.ወአጽናፈ: ጽንፍ — and the ends of (ወ- + plural አጽናፍ, construct)
glossary.ወኤልያስ: ኤልያስ — Elijah, Elias (proper name; here a personal name, son of Arni; ወ- 'and')
glossary.ወእለኒ: እለ — and those also (ወ- + relative pronoun pl. + enclitic -ኒ 'also')
glossary.ወእማቲሆሙ: እም — mother (noun, plural እማት + -ሆሙ '3mp their'; ወ- 'and')
glossary.ወእደዊሁ: እድ — hand (noun, plural እደው, እደዊ- + -ሁ '3ms his'; ወ- 'and')
glossary.ወከመ: ከመ — that, so that (conjunction; ወ- 'and') · and as (ወከመ ዝ 'and as this')
glossary.ወከማሁ: ከማሁ — and likewise (ወ- 'and' + adverb, 'like him, thus')
glossary.ወኮነ: ኮነ — and it was, became (ወ- + 3m sg perfect)
glossary.ወኵሉ: ኵሉ — and all, every (ወ- + noun, before a noun with suffix) · and everyone (ወኵሉ ያነክር 'and everyone marvels')
glossary.ወዓዲ: ዓዲ — and still, also, moreover (ወ- + adverb)
glossary.ወየሐምይዎ: ሐመየ — blame, reproach (3mp imperfect + -ዎ '3ms him'; ወ- 'and'; sense uncertain) (?)
glossary.ወያሤንዩ: አሠነየ — make good, make pleasant (3mp imperfect, causative of ሠነየ; ወ- 'and')
glossary.ወይብልዎ: ብህለ — and they say to him (ወ- + 3mp imperfect ይብሉ + -ሎ '3ms to him', joined as ዎ)
glossary.ወይትዔገሶሙ: ተዐገሠ — be patient with, bear with (3ms imperfect + -ሙ '3mp them'; ወ- 'and'; the book spells ተዔገሰ) (?)
glossary.ወይዌድስዎ: ወደሰ — praise, extol (3mp imperfect + -ዎ '3ms him'; ወ- 'and')
glossary.ወጽዑነ: ጽዑን — laden, loaded (adjective, accusative singular form; ወ- 'and'; agreement with plural ሰረገላተ unclear) (?)
glossary.ውስተ: ውስተ — in, within, into · to, among (ወለአከ ውስተ ኵሉ ነጋድያን 'and he sent to all the merchants') · at (ውስተ መድረከ ኆኃቲሃ 'at the threshold of her doors')
glossary.ውእቱ: ውእቱ — he, it (3ms independent pronoun; also serves as copula 'is')
glossary.ዕበዩ: ዕበይ — greatness, majesty (noun + -ሁ '3ms his', contracted ዕበዩ)
glossary.ዕንቈ: ዕንቍ — jewel, precious stone (noun, construct 'stones of'; ዕንቈ ባሕርያተ 'pearl-stones')
glossary.ዘሄደ: ሄደ — go, walk (3ms perfect; beside the usual ሖረ, and a form I cannot check (?); ዘ- 'that, because')
glossary.ዘቤተ: ቤት — of the house of (ዘ- 'of, that of' + ቤተ, construct 'house of')
glossary.ዘአንገሠ: አንገሠ — make king, enthrone (3ms perfect, causative of ነገሠ; ዘ- 'that, because he')
glossary.ዘእ: ዘእንበለ — without, apart from (preposition; written split, ዘእ ፡ ንበለ)
glossary.ዘይትፈቀድ: ተፈቀደ — what is needed, required (ዘ- + 3ms imperfect passive of ፈቀደ)
glossary.ዝ: ዝ — this (demonstrative, masc. sg.; ወከመ ዝ 'and as this')
glossary.ዝውእቱ: ውእቱ — this is he, that is (he who) · 'this very one', ዝ + ውእቱ in apposition (ዝውእቱ ብሩሀ ገጽ ይኩን 'let this one, bright of face, be…')
glossary.የ: ሠናይ — final syllable of ሠናየ 'good' (accusative), split from ሠና by a wordspace
glossary.የሀቡ: ወሀበ — that they give (3mp subjunctive, G; after ከመ)
glossary.ያምልክዎ: አምለከ — worship, serve (3mp subjunctive + -ዎ '3ms him'; denominative of አምላክ)
glossary.ያአምር: አእመረ — he knows, discerns (3ms imperfect, caus., ʿ-m-r)
glossary.ያዐርፍ: አዕረፈ — rest, come to rest (3ms imperfect, A stem used intransitively; cf. ወአዕረፈ in ch. 42)
glossary.ያገብኦን: አግብአ — hand over, bring back (3ms imperfect, causative of ገብአ, + -ኦን '3fp them')
glossary.ይሠረዉ: ሠረወ — be rooted out, uprooted (3mp subjunctive; read as intransitive with subject ጣዖታት, or active 'root out') (?)
glossary.ይሥራዕ: ሠርዐ — that he ordain, set in order (3ms jussive, G)
glossary.ይቤሎ: ብህለ — he said to him (3ms perfect ይቤ of the defective verb b-h-l, + -ሎ 'to him')
glossary.ይብልዎ: ብህለ — they say to him (3mp imperfect ይብሉ + -ሎ '3ms to him', joined as ዎ)
glossary.ይብልዎያአምሮሙ: ብህለ — they say to him (3mp imperfect ይብልዎ) fused with ያአምሮሙ 'he knows them' (አእመረ, 3ms imperfect + -ሙ), written together without a wordspace
glossary.ይትባረኩ: ተባረከ — be blessed (3mp imperfect, T stem passive; Genesis 22:18)
glossary.ይትዔገሰነ: ተዐገሠ — be patient with, bear with (3ms imperfect + -ነ '1cp us'; the book spells ተዔገሰ) (?)
glossary.ይትፈነዉ: ፈነወ — send (3mp subjunctive, passive T stem 'that they be sent')
glossary.ይነብሩ: ነበረ — they live, dwell (3mp imperfect, G, n-b-r)
glossary.ይንበሩ: ነበረ — that they live (3mp subjunctive, n-b-r)
glossary.ይንግሡ: ነገሠ — that they reign, be kings (3mp subjunctive)
glossary.ይኴንን: ኰነነ — he rule, judge (3ms imperfect/jussive, D)
glossary.ይገብርዋ: ገብረ — they do it (3mp imperfect + -ዋ '3fs it')
glossary.ዮስ: ዮስ — ዮስ (personal name, unidentified) ; perhaps the end of the preceding name, split by the wordspace
glossary.ደቀ: ደቅ — child, youth, servant (noun, construct 'child of'; the singular beside ደቂቅ 'sons'; sense here uncertain) (?)
glossary.ደቂቀ: ደቂቅ — sons, children (plural ደቂቅ, construct 'sons of')
glossary.ደወለ: ደወል — boundary, border (noun; construct/accusative 'boundary of'; uncertain)
glossary.ዲያቆናት: ዲያቆን — deacon (noun, plural ዲያቆናት; ሊቀ ዲያቆናት 'chief of deacons')
glossary.ዳዊት: ዳዊት — David (proper name) · 'ዳዊት' also in ማኅፈደ ዳዊት 'tower (?) of David' (genitive after a construct)
glossary.ገበርከ: ገብረ — you have done (2ms perfect, g-b-r)
glossary.ገባር: ገባር — workman, labourer (noun; agent noun of ገብረ)
glossary.ገጾሙ: ገጽ — their faces (noun + -ሆሙ '3mp their', written ገጾሙ)
glossary.ጦፌል: ጦፌል — Tofel (personal name, unidentified; cf. Tophel) (?)
glossary.ጸዋሬ: ጸዋሪ — bearer, carrier (agent noun, construct 'bearer of')
glossary.፵፫: ፵፫ — 43, spoken አርብዓ ወሠለስቱ (ʾärbəʿa wä-śälästu) 'forty-three'; chapter number (numeral)
